_about: Korean names of the chemical elements for the substance search: the element's CAS gets its Korean name as a registry-tier synonym, so a bare element name (니켈, 납, 크롬) ranks the element above its compounds. Each item names its source; 'corroborated_by' lists where the same spelling appears in local official data (KISCHEM 화학물질안전원 rows, NCIS 국문명, law.go.kr lists in backend/data/trade_controls/kr_lists). 'expect_en' is checked by build_synonyms.py against the CAS's English names in terminology.db so a wrong CAS fails the build. Silicon's old name 실리콘 is left out on purpose: in Korean it usually means silicone (polymer). Plutonium (7440-07-5) is not in chemical_terms and is left out.
